LESSON: WATER SWIMMING

Grade: PP2

Strand: Pool safety By the end of the sub-strand • Guide learners name the 1. What is th
Topic 11.2: Water SWIMMING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Water SWIMMING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. confidently move around the 15 Lessons swimming
2. opening eyes confidently in water for safe swimming
3. identify basic floating techniques for swimming 116
4. appreciate the use of water for recreation different floating techniques float and walk safely in water pool Core-Competence to be developed

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. confidently move around the 15 Lessons swimming
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to confidently move around the 15 Lessons swimming. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. opening eyes confidently in water for safe swimming
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to opening eyes confidently in water for safe swimming. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. identify basic floating techniques for swimming 116
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify basic floating techniques for swimming 116. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the use of water for recreation different floating techniques float and walk safely in water pool Core-Competence to be developed
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of water for recreation different floating techniques float and walk safely in water pool Core-Competence to be developed. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Water SWIMMING.
2. Explain Water SWIMMING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Water SWIMMING.
4. Show that you can: confidently move around the 15 Lessons swimming
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Water SWIMMING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Water SWIMMING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. confidently move around the 15 Lessons swimming
2. opening eyes confidently in water for safe swimming
3. identify basic floating techniques for swimming 116
4. appreciate the use of water for recreation different floating techniques float and walk safely in water pool Core-Competence to be developed

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
